description: Source code for a file enumerator class in the Chromium project, handling file system traversal on Windows.

classes.name: FileEnumerator
classes.description: Class for enumerating files and directories on Windows, supporting recursive search and pattern filtering.

classes.name: FileEnumerator::FileInfo
classes.description: Structure holding information about a file or directory, such as name, size, and last modified time.

methods.name: BuildSearchFilter
methods.description: Builds a search filter path based on the folder search policy and pattern.

methods.name: FileEnumerator::FileInfo::IsDirectory
methods.description: Checks if the current file info represents a directory.

methods.name: FileEnumerator::FileInfo::GetName
methods.description: Returns the name of the file or directory.

methods.name: FileEnumerator::FileInfo::GetSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the file.

methods.name: FileEnumerator::FileInfo::GetLastModifiedTime
methods.description: Returns the last modified time of the file.

methods.name: FileEnumerator::Next
methods.description: Advances to the next file or directory in the enumeration.
